sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु सुग्रीवो विनतम् नाम यूथपम् ।अब्रवीत् राम सांनिध्ये लक्ष्मणस्य च धीमतः ॥४-४०-१६॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu sugrīvo vinatam nāma yūthapam ।abravīt rāma sāṁnidhye lakṣmaṇasya ca dhīmataḥ ॥4-40-16॥

translations.english: 'In response to Rama's desire, Sugriva beckoned a troopleader called Vinata who was wellbuilt and lofty like a mountain. And thundering like a cloud, said to him in the presence of Rama and wise Lakshmana:
